addition.item: First public release of the Joomla 6 ticket desk with registered-user site portal and administrator staff desk
Private attachments for portal and administrator with configurable allowed types and optional retention purge
Configurable private attachment folder name under the private storage root
Staff and requester email notifications with Immediate delivery (default) or Queued Scheduler outbox
Privacy, Action Log, and task plugins packaged with the component
Registered portal menu auto-create on install or update when none exists
Fifteen packaged locales for administrator, site, and Action Log strings

change.item: Ticket statuses are open and closed only; legacy pending rows migrate to open
Portal owners may set priority and close or reopen their own tickets
Author-copy email applies only to portal user replies, not administrator staff replies
Mail delivery Options: Immediate or Queued via Scheduler task devartsupport.send_mail
Portal ticket logic lives in PortalTicketService with shared AbstractTicketService helpers
Safer portal Close control uses quiet styling and a confirmation prompt

fix.item: Atomic admin ticket save via integer version optimistic lock with expected_version form binding
Portal reply reopen uses conditional SQL so concurrent staff status changes are not overwritten
ZIP uploads accept host finfo MIME variants and verify local-header magic bytes before store
Validated ZIP and RAR uploads are not blocked by Joomla isSafeFile archive content scans
Portal TicketDesk falls back when the site Extension portal getter is missing or uninitialised
Installer ensures ticket columns with per-ALTER error logging so one failed ALTER cannot skip version
Installer preflight purges leftover internal SQL updates after the numbering reset
Attachment retention purge deletes private files before database rows and keeps rows on failed deletes
Mail queue uses UTF-8-safe truncation and purges failed rows older than 30 days
Configurable portal create and reply rate limits in Options

note.item: Install and update only through pkg_devartsupport
Installing over former internal 1.0.x builds is supported (numbering reset)
Guest tickets, assignment, modules, and live chat remain out of scope
